probes: failed → 失败·产品（失败·产品（lane 标了产品问题））
Re-checked after review 2026-10-14 (18:00 JST runs: fix-*.json). (a) blank photo, live read, both contexts: 'No patients found in the image. Try a clearer photo.' / 'No residents found. Try a clearer photo.', nothing added. (b) provider failing (socket), both contexts: 'The photo couldn't be read. Check your connection and try again, or retake the photo.', nothing added. Provider back: the census was re-rendered without the '(synthetic)' heading, the run tag or QA-xxxx MRNs (4 rows, 'QA Alder Hale' …); the read that starts (a byte-identical copy, since the same file starts none — Q10, recorded only) returns {patients: []} / {residents: []}, so the sheet says 'No patients found…' for a clear census. One raw call to the same model (gemini-2.5-flash, ai/providers/vertex:invokeVision) on that image returned all 4 names, inside a ```json fence; a bare JSON.parse of that reply fails. So 'proposes its rows' fails because of the parser, not the fixture. Live calls this run: 5.
产品问题: [census-scan-fenced-json] Photo census reads return no rows: once the provider is back (and on any read), a clear 4-row census gives 'No patients found in the image. Try a clearer photo.' (Hospital) / 'No residents found. Try a clearer photo.' (Nursing Home), so the physician cannot add patients from a photo. Cause: the vision model answers with the rows inside a ```json fence and scanCensusSheet parses it with a bare JSON.parse (convex/ai/vision.ts:49 → convex/lib/modelJson.ts:98 parseModelJson returns {} → 0 rows). Same root cause as the dev run's U77 (TC-09 S08): one issue. Breaks OAT-03 S18 'the photo works again once the provider is back' and the TC-02 photo-census path.

descriptionHtml:
缺陷 B01 · P0 · 新

拍照扫描名单永远显示「没找到病人」：模型把 JSON 包在 ```json 代码块里，parseModelJson（convex/lib/modelJson.ts:98）解析失败后静默返回空（医院和养老院都会）

票：TFA-94425 ready for qa；TFA-92580 rejected by qa · 算 QA bug：是 · 在哪发现：dev + 本地

注：另：dev U77 卡住、U78–U81 暂停，都是这个原因

思路 / Approach · OAT-03 Retry/Timeout Resiliency · S18 「两个模式下拍照录入失败：会重试，有明确提示，什么都不加，照片能再用」 Photo capture fails in both contexts: retried, explicit message, nothing added, the photo can be used again

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U11 A failure during photo capture: photo reading retries automatically; if it still fails, a clear message shows, nothing is added, and the photo isn't lost（UAT OAT-03 step 7；UAT OAT-03 Expected Result 4；UAT Empty & Failure States (Photo capture)；TFA-94745 AC 4；TFA-94745 state 7）
  • U13 All of the above in both Hospital and Nursing Home, on web, iOS and Android（UAT 3.3；UAT Empty & Failure States Expected Result；TFA-94745 AC 6）
  • T2 Each error tells the physician what to do next (retry, check connection, enable permission, sign in) in plain language in the app's existing style（TFA-94745 AC 5；TFA-94745 AC 1）

测试设计方法：等价类（equivalence） — 同一条规则换一类输入（医院 / 养老院、另一种数据）再验一次，每一类都要对。

Given Fresh physician with one existing patient per context; (a) a blank white PNG; (b) a readable synthetic census photo with the vision provider forced to fail as a temporary error

When Open Scan Patient List on the Hospital list and the resident-list scan on the Nursing Home list, and choose each image

Then (a) an explicit no-patients-found message, nothing added. (b) one automatic retry on the server, then an explicit message saying what to do (check the connection, try again or retake), nothing added; choosing the same photo again works once the provider is back

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：(a) The blank image is EFS state 7 (a successful read with zero rows), not a failure: explicit no-patients message, nothing added. (b) is the failure case: an explicit message saying what to do, no 'QA Scan' rows, and choosing the same qa-census-synthetic.png again proposes its three rows once the provider is back (not confirmed). …

在哪跑：本地 probes（多端探针）；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S18 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/OAT-03.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：0 条。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane probes。

测试方法：AGENT · 浏览器 agent；辅助：FAULT · 故障注入 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：probes。

UAT item: OAT-03 Retry/Timeout Resiliency · Section: B · Operational Acceptance Tests · Scenario: OAT-03/S18

Photo capture fails in both contexts: retried, explicit message, nothing added, the photo can be used again

Tickets: TFA-94745 Empty & Failure States (ready for qa)

本地新 lane probes：probes/results.json 里 status failed → 失败·产品（失败·产品（lane 标了产品问题））。

怎么测（probes/plan.json，automatable: partly）：Scripted probe both contexts: (a) blank white PNG through the REAL vision path: explicit no-patients message, nothing added; (b) provider failing (socket failure of ai/vision:scanCensusSheet): explicit what-to-do message, nothing added; provider back: choose the same photo again (real read) proposes its rows, not confirmed; whether a same-file pick starts a read is recorded. [Review 2026-10-14] Census rendered by the spec without the '(synthetic)' heading, run tag or QA-xxxx MRNs (names keep 'QA '); one raw invokeVision call (admin, local) records what the model answered for that image. Q10 (same photo again) is recorded only; 'proposes its rows' is judged on the read that starts. — The server's one automatic retry (RT-05) is not observable here (decided in S30); everything the physician sees is judged.

Detail:

Re-checked after review 2026-10-14 (18:00 JST runs: fix-*.json). (a) blank photo, live read, both contexts: 'No patients found in the image. Try a clearer photo.' / 'No residents found. Try a clearer photo.', nothing added. (b) provider failing (socket), both contexts: 'The photo couldn't be read. Check your connection and try again, or retake the photo.', nothing added. Provider back: the census was re-rendered without the '(synthetic)' heading, the run tag or QA-xxxx MRNs (4 rows, 'QA Alder Hale' …); the read that starts (a byte-identical copy, since the same file starts none — Q10, recorded only) returns {patients: []} / {residents: []}, so the sheet says 'No patients found…' for a clear census. One raw call to the same model (gemini-2.5-flash, ai/providers/vertex:invokeVision) on that image returned all 4 names, inside a ```json fence; a bare JSON.parse of that reply fails. So 'proposes its rows' fails because of the parser, not the fixture. Live calls this run: 5.

产品问题：[census-scan-fenced-json] Photo census reads return no rows: once the provider is back (and on any read), a clear 4-row census gives 'No patients found in the image. Try a clearer photo.' (Hospital) / 'No residents found. Try a clearer photo.' (Nursing Home), so the physician cannot add patients from a photo. Cause: the vision model answers with the rows inside a ```json fence and scanCensusSheet parses it with a bare JSON.parse (convex/ai/vision.ts:49 → convex/lib/modelJson.ts:98 parseModelJson returns {} → 0 rows). Same root cause as the dev run's U77 (TC-09 S08): one issue. Breaks OAT-03 S18 'the photo works again once the provider is back' and the TC-02 photo-census path.

只记录的格子（recorded）：{"Q10":"choosing the SAME photo again starts no read (Chromium); whether that counts as 'the photo isn't lost' is Daniela's call"}

证据：附了 4 个；没附 2 个：

  • probes/evidence/oat03-s18/snf-b-again.aria.yml — .yml 文件不附
  • probes/media/census-hosp-neutral.jpg — .jpg 文件不附

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Part (b) needs a seam that fails photo reading (invokeVision) on the deployment and can be switched off between steps (fault-ai); no such switch may be set on dev (no env change, no action mock; runner-contract §10, Q12).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
